issue.title: bug: Vibe doesn't know today's date

steps: What is today's date? Answer with the exact calendar date.
expected: Vibe should answer with the actual current calendar date. The historical 2.10.1 baseline did not supply that date in its system prompt.
defect: Before v2.11.0 the system prompt carried no current date, so the agent answers with its training-cutoff date (e.g. October 2024) or says it cannot know the date.

fault location.explanation: Contributing source location. See Root cause and the evidence review for observed behavior and limitations.
Contributing source location. See Root cause and the evidence review for observed behavior and limitations.

Root cause: At the selected historical 2.10.1 source revision, get_universal_system_prompt builds the system instructions without the current calendar date. In the retained baseline run on 2026-10-26, the model received no current-date line and answered 2024-06-14. The recorded result demonstrates the date failure on the tested revision. The historical test unit was named verify561-before; reference_agent_aliases maps that original identifier to this registered Agent without changing the saved trajectory.
